revision_summary: Two quote timestamp errors (wrong_ts, both minor) need correction: (1) 'I don't remember I request a information' should be timestamped 00:21, not 00:00 (00:00 is only 'Hello. This is Parker.'/'Hey.'); (2) 'Two two sounded.' should be timestamped 05:44, not 05:11 (05:11 is the rep's question 'Is there a day that'd be best for you, Vincent?'). Fix both ts fields in script_coverage. Additionally: (a) reconcile the cherry_pick_moments[1] classification label 'cross_sell_miss' which doesn't match its own cited schema_reference (rebuttals.send_proposal_before_meeting) — relabel to a rebuttal/hard-rule deviation category; (b) reconcile the contradiction between objections[2] marking the proposal-request objection 'resolved: true' and cherry_pick_moments[1] describing the same rep response as an ambiguous soft-variant that leaves the hard-rule unenforced — pick one consistent read or explicitly note the tension; (c) add analysis of the 00:27 legitimacy/specificity moment (protocols.how_did_you_get_my_number pattern) which is the clearest protocol-adherence beat in the call and currently goes unmentioned; (d) add a conditional_booking_detection note to the handoff_brief flagging the 14-day gap between setter call and appointment date (customer leaving for 10-day vacation) as elevated no-show/cooling-off risk, consistent with schema's bill_collection cooling-off-period language; (e) soften the trajectory_verdict's confidence that the customer's energy genuinely 'turned around' — the customer's actual words during this stretch (a flat 'Yeah' followed by asking to have something sent rather than book a call) support a more ambivalent/stalling read that the current verdict doesn't acknowledge.
